text: This wiki is set up to be used with ChatGPT.
The delete guard is installed for ChatGPT, entered in its hooks file, and is this Moblee's own copy.

ChatGPT is not signed in on this Mac, so the guard could not be proved. Sign in to ChatGPT and run this again. To check: in ChatGPT, open the ChatGPT menu, choose Settings, choose Hooks (under Coding), open "User config", and find the hook whose command ends bash-guard.py. If a Trust button shows beside it, press it, and make sure its switch is on.
The last install ran to the end.
